# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 with Graphite GPU bindings** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0-preview)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 updates the engine to Skia m152 and adds early Graphite GPU backend bindings. Alongside the milestone bump, this release fixes two native use-after-free bugs and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak, adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API, and lands a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — The bundled engine advances to Chrome milestone m152, picking up the upstream m151/m152 stability fixes merged during the preview. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))
- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds early bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, laying the groundwork for the next-generation GPU pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))

## API Surface

- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works consistently across GPU backends instead of requiring backend-specific code. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Vulkan via Silk.NET** — A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package brings Silk.NET-based Vulkan interop, now exercised by Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Two native use-after-free bugs fixed** — SKRegion.SpanIterator now roots its owning SKRegion, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* root their pixel source, closing native use-after-free crashes. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed** — SKImage.Create no longer leaks its CoTaskMem pixel buffer when raster allocation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Allocation and lookup hot paths trimmed** — GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on its null-terminated path, SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map, SKData.SaveTo drops a double buffer copy, and the handle dictionary skip-registration reflection check is now cached. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **FreeType powers Nano Server font support** — Nano Server containers now render text via FreeType instead of relying on a font stack that isn't available there. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **New containerized test legs and deterministic bindings** — Adds Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server containerized test legs, and makes binding generation deterministic across build platforms. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515), [#4612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4612))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Converts the HarfBuzzSharp solution files to .slnx format and adds the containerized Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test legs.
